<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Register or re-register a station"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/stations"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Creates a station with the given capability set, or — if `stationId` already exists — replaces its capability set (e.g. recertifying a station for a new capability). This is deliberately idempotent by client-supplied id: re-registering the same `stationId` upserts rather than erroring or duplicating, which is what closes the pull-dispatch gap for HTTP-only smoke testing (without this endpoint there is no way to create a station over HTTP, so `task-claims` against a freshly started server always 404s).

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}

<ParamsDetails
  parameters={[{"name":"Idempotency-Key","in":"header","required":true,"description":"Caller-supplied key, 1-128 printable ASCII characters (a UUID minted once per LOGICAL submit; a retry reuses it, a new user action mints a new one). Required on every POST: a missing key is `400 idempotency-key-required`, a malformed one `400 idempotency-key-invalid`. The key is global to the service: a retry with the same method, path and body replays the stored answer (status, body and `Location`) with `Idempotency-Replayed: true` and runs nothing; the same key with a different method, path or body is `409 idempotency-key-reused`. Stored answers are a 2xx and the refusals that are FINAL for the request (ADR-0066); a refusal whose cause is state that can change (RETRYABLE) is not stored, its key is released, and a retry executes again — a different body under a released key is a new request, not `idempotency-key-reused`.\n","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":128,"pattern":"^[ -~]+$","example":"6f1c2a3e-9b1d-4c1a-8f0e-2d5b7c9a1e44"}}]}
>
  
</ParamsDetails>

<RequestSchema

  body={{"required":true,"content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"type":"object","required":["stationId","capabilities"],"properties":{"stationId":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"description":"Client-supplied station identifier; re-using an existing one upserts capabilities. Must be non-empty: the API treats \"\" as a missing field and rejects it with 400.\n","example":"station-1"},"capabilities":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"items":{"type":"string","nullable":true,"description":"A null item is accepted and treated as an empty capability string (Go's JSON decoding cannot distinguish them).\n","example":"pick"}},"locationCode":{"type":"string","nullable":true,"description":"Optional facility-layout LocationCode identifying where this station physically sits (ADR-0024). Omitted entirely — or an explicit null, which is treated exactly the same — means unchecked: no role validation is attempted. When supplied and the location-role lookup is configured, a LocationCode that KNOWINGLY resolves to a role other than WorkCenter is rejected (422); an unrecognized LocationCode, or an unavailable lookup, fails open and is recorded unchecked.\n","example":"WH1-STOR-AMB-A07-01-01-A"}},"example":{"stationId":"station-1","capabilities":["pick"]},"title":"RegisterStationRequest"},"example":{"stationId":"station-1","capabilities":["pick"]}}}}}
